name: Console
title: Templates/Shells/Console
summary: The application shell every signed-in page renders inside: a full-height navigation rail on the left that the user resizes by its edge and collapses from its foot (the product wordmark, the ⌘K palette with its Recents, navigation, Actions and Account groups, the navigation Menu with its grouped sections and drill-in levels, and the account menu with the theme switch, the Upgrade to Pro action and the system status at its foot) and a content zone on the right whose global header carries the breadcrumb on every level (one unlinked crumb on a first-level list, which opens on its controls row with no page heading), the search affordance, the Create button, the Agent button and the account avatar. The search is a 32px field-shaped button while the bar’s content box is at least `--container-2xl` (752px) wide and an outlined IconButton below it; below `md` the rail becomes a Drawer opened from the hamburger that leads the wordmark. First-level lists, detail pages with their tabs and Home all render inside it. Built from `PageTabs`, `Sidebar`, `Menu`, `Command`, `DropdownMenu`, `ThemeSwitcher`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `GlobalHeader`, `Breadcrumb`, `Button`, `ButtonHighlight`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `Kbd`, `Drawer` and, per page, `Tabs`, `Select`, `Tag`, `Input` and `Card`; the page bodies here are stand-ins, the real ones are the TableView and DetailsPage templates.

variants.name: DetailPage
variants.summary: A resource detail page: the breadcrumb reads Resources, the resource, then its environment, whose last crumb is a Select that searches the resource’s environments, tags each with its deployment policy and offers Add Environment at its foot; a full-bleed Tabs bar under the header carries the Overview, Deployments and Settings tabs with the outlined Deploy action, and the content scrolls beneath it.

variants.name: Notifications
variants.summary: The same ListPage frame built on `AppLayout`: the bell in the header carries an unread `Badge` and opens the notifications region on the right (the tools region of the layout, a Drawer on a narrow screen), which lists deploys, invitations and alerts with Mark all as read and Clear all, and offers Edit and Redeploy on each deploy; a failed deploy also shows as a flash `Alert` above the page in the layout's notifications slot, and an empty list reads You are all caught up.
